properties.source: Lusatian Neisse from the Czech–German–Polish tripoint near Zittau to its mouth in the Oder at Ratzdorf, drawn by hand through the border towns it passes (Zittau, Gorlitz/Zgorzelec, Rothenburg, Bad Muskau, Forst, Guben; general-knowledge coordinates) and joined to the Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) 'Oder' 130 vertex at Ratzdorf. Approximate (~5 km).
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9
